DESCRIPTION: Everything the epic 22 phase retros (2026-10-06) left open, after PR #13 merged and its migrations reached production. Ranked by risk: P1 data correctness and two owner decisions, P2 currency and import gaps, P3 polish. Build order and sources: epic-23-build-order.md.

SUMMARY: Splitting the latest row of a recurring series keeps the schedule
USER_STORY: As a user, I want splitting my latest recurring transaction to leave the series running, so next month still posts.
DESCRIPTION: split_transaction inserts every line with is_recurring false and no interval, then deletes the source. Splitting the row that carries the schedule therefore ends the series silently (epic 22 phase 1 retro, LED-261 finding). Owner decision in /plan: (A) the first line inherits the schedule and recurrence_next_posted; (B) the split is refused for the row carrying the schedule, with a message saying why; (C) behaviour stays, and the split dialog warns that the series ends.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Decision recorded in the retro; (b) after splitting the latest row of a series and loading the app, the next due date posts exactly once (A), or the split is refused with a reason (B), or the dialog warns before the split (C); (c) splitting an older row of the series is unchanged; (d) migration, if the RPC changes, applies cleanly to an empty database in CI; (e) SQL check inside begin ... rollback, or a unit test, in the retro.

SUMMARY: A setting changed offline survives a reload
USER_STORY: As a user, I want a setting I change offline to stay changed, even if I reload before I am back online.
DESCRIPTION: Settings changed on this device that the account has not stored yet are kept in memory only (AuthContext.tsx, LED-263). A reload while offline shows the cached profile without the change, and nothing ever sends it (epic 22 phase 2 retro; the LED-263 plan accepted this). Keep pending settings in this browser, scoped to the user, and send them when the app is back online. Sign-out clears them with the other personal copies (LED-268).
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Change a setting offline, reload offline: the setting shows the new value; (b) back online, the value reaches profiles.preferences without user action; (c) a newer value saved from another device is not overwritten by an older pending one (the rule is stated in the retro); (d) sign-out leaves no pending-settings key; (e) unit test for the pending store in src/lib.

SUMMARY: Errors on signed-out pages reach the operator
USER_STORY: As the operator, I want errors on the login and public pages reported, so a broken sign-in is not invisible.
DESCRIPTION: reportError.ts returns early without a session, because error_events takes the owner from the session and allows signed-in inserts only (LED-258; epic 22 phase 1 retro). Opening inserts to anonymous users would let anyone write to the table. Owner decision in /plan: (A) a security definer RPC that accepts signed-out reports with size caps and a rate limit, rows marked anonymous; (B) signed-out errors stay unreported, and the release checklist says so.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Decision recorded in the retro; (A) a forced error on /login appears as an anonymous row; oversized payloads are cut to the cap; repeated reports are limited; no direct anonymous insert on error_events is possible; migration applies cleanly in CI and passes the db lint; (B) the release checklist and reportError.ts comment state that signed-out errors are not reported.

SUMMARY: Live checks for payments between two currencies
USER_STORY: As the owner, I want the cross-currency paths LED-269 added checked in the real app, not only in unit tests.
DESCRIPTION: Not checked live in epic 22 (phase 2 and phase 3 retros): editing a saved card or loan payment between two currencies; queued offline payments and imports between two currencies; an imported transfer from another currency (the "Sent" field, unit-tested only); Pay now on a real overdue loan bill (LED-272); card reminder claims on two devices showing OS notifications (LED-266, checked at the REST level only). Verification only: each failure becomes its own ticket.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Each of the five paths run in the browser and recorded PASS or FAIL in the retro, with the data used; (b) a FAIL opens a new LED ticket rather than a fix in this one; (c) no console errors on the checked pages.

SUMMARY: The receiving account's list shows the payment's own currency
USER_STORY: As a user, I want a card payment from my EUR account to show in the card's currency on the card's list.
DESCRIPTION: A card payment or loan repayment from another currency shows "+$1,000.00 ... EUR" on the card's or loan's list: the amount is in the account's currency but the row chip names the source account's currency (epic 22 phase 3 retro). LED-185 transfers already behave this way. Read the row currency from the side of the transfer being shown.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) A EUR to USD card payment shows USD on the card's list and EUR on the source's; (b) the same for a loan repayment and a plain LED-185 transfer; (c) same-currency rows unchanged; (d) unit test for the chip currency.

SUMMARY: Activity Sum and Month jump skip the empty currency bucket of a transfer
USER_STORY: As a user, I want the Activity sum to show only currencies that moved, not "EUR 0.00" for a transfer.
DESCRIPTION: A transfer between two currencies nets to zero for the list total but still opens its currency's bucket, so the Sum and Month jump read "Sum €0.00 · −$1,817.40" (epic 22 phase 3 retro). Drop a bucket whose only rows are transfers that net to zero; keep a real zero from income and expenses.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) A month with one EUR to USD transfer and USD spending shows only the USD total; (b) a currency whose income and expenses net to zero still shows 0.00; (c) Month jump totals match the Sum; (d) unit test.

SUMMARY: Import says why it is blocked
USER_STORY: As a user, I want to know why Import is disabled, so I can fix it without guessing.
DESCRIPTION: With an empty Received or Sent field on a cross-currency row, Import is disabled and the field is outlined, but no text says why (ImportCSVDialog.tsx, epic 22 phase 3 retro). Add a short reason next to the Import button and name the field on the row (FormError pattern, LED-55).
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) With one empty Received field, text near Import names how many rows need an amount; (b) the field has aria-invalid and a described-by error; (c) filling the field clears the text and enables Import; (d) checked in the accessibility tree.

SUMMARY: Overspending past cycles name their window
USER_STORY: As a user, I want a past week or quarter in Overspending labelled by its dates, not "This week".
DESCRIPTION: overspending.ts returns fixed chips: "This week", "This quarter" and "This year", even when a past cycle is selected (epic 22 phase 3 retro; yearly since LED-244, weekly and quarterly since LED-271). Label a past cycle by its window (e.g. "Sep 22 to 28", "Q3 2026", "2025").
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) The current cycle keeps "This week", "This quarter" or "This year"; (b) a past cycle shows its window; (c) unit tests for the three periods, current and past.

SUMMARY: A failed template upload says the save failed
USER_STORY: As a user, I want the error to say which step failed.
DESCRIPTION: When the one-time upload of old browser templates fails, the banner reads "Couldn't load your templates. Couldn't save this template." because TransactionsPage.tsx always prefixes the load message (epic 22 phase 1 retro, LED-257). Accurate but awkward: show the upload failure on its own.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) A forced upload failure shows one sentence about saving, with Retry; (b) a forced read failure still shows the load message; (c) no change when both succeed.

SUMMARY: The Account page search has a name
USER_STORY: As a screen-reader user, I want the account search named like the Activity one.
DESCRIPTION: AccountTransactionsPage.tsx (the search Input near line 764) is named only by its placeholder, the same gap LED-273 (b) closed on Activity (epic 22 phase 4 retro). Name it the same way.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) The input has an accessible name in the accessibility tree; (b) it matches the Activity search wording.

SUMMARY: The account picker names its first option when it opens
USER_STORY: As a screen-reader user, I want the account picker to announce the highlighted account as soon as it opens.
DESCRIPTION: AccountCombobox.tsx (cmdk CommandGroup items in a Popover) opens with the first account aria-selected but no aria-activedescendant until an arrow press, even with the LED-273 cmdk patch (epic 22 phase 4 retro). Trace the grouped-items-in-a-popover path; keep the patch working for the palette.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) On open, the input's aria-activedescendant names the highlighted account; (b) arrows, typing and Enter still work; (c) the palette is unchanged; (d) checked in the accessibility tree.

SUMMARY: Skeleton bars are visible on the grey page
USER_STORY: As a user, I want loading bars I can see wherever they sit.
DESCRIPTION: --skeleton (#C5C3CB, index.css) is 1.5:1 on cards but 1.20:1 on the grey page (#DEDDE3); LED-275 asked only for the card (epic 22 phase 4 retro). Find the skeletons that sit on the page, not a card, and give them a visible fill, light mode only.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) List of page-level skeletons in the retro; (b) each at 1.5:1 or more against its background; (c) card skeletons and dark mode unchanged.

SUMMARY: The Account side column follows the design width, or the cap stays
USER_STORY: As a user on a wide screen, I want the account page laid out as designed.
DESCRIPTION: The account page side column stays 320px against 400 in 4a at 1920, waiting on the width-cap decision (LED-152 retro, "Width caps: keep or remove": Account detail kept from the code, never viewed at 1920; epic 22 phase 4 retro, LED-274). Measure at 1280 and 1920 against 4a, then widen or record the cap as decided.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) Measured at 1280 and 1920 against 4a, with screenshots in the retro; (b) either the column is 400px where the content fits, or the LED-152 table records the cap as viewed and kept; (c) no horizontal scroll at 1280.

SUMMARY: Trace the 400 on the dev login page
USER_STORY: As a developer, I want a clean console on the login page, so real errors stand out.
DESCRIPTION: A 400 shows in the console on the dev /login page before sign-in. Not investigated; it predates epic 22 and was also seen in the epics 15-19 sweep (epic 22 phase 1 retro). Find the request and fix it, or record why it is expected.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) The failing request and its cause in the retro; (b) fixed, or documented as expected with the reason; (c) the live /login console checked too.

USER_STORY: As a developer, I want no unused default assets in public/.
DESCRIPTION: public/favicon.svg is Vite's default bolt and nothing references it: index.html and the manifest use l-black.png (epic 22 phase 4 retro). Delete it, or redraw it from LedgerMark and reference it.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) No Vite bolt in public/; (b) if kept, index.html references it and it renders in light and dark tabs; (c) build passes.
